title: Ctrl drag asks how many to move
why: His note: in the stash, ctrl drag an item to the backpack should ask how many to transfer. A Ctrl drag of a stack, stash to backpack or back, now opens a small prompt: a number and a slider with the most preselected, minus, plus, Half and All buttons for a pad, Enter moves, Esc cancels. A plain drag is unchanged and moves one.
now: Ctrl and drag a stack between the stash and the backpack to choose how many move. Enter confirms, Esc cancels.
